Origin and meaning

The name Steven has Greek roots and means “crown (variant of Stephen)”.

About the name Steven

A variant of Stephen that became hugely popular in the mid-20th century.

As a gift or a tattoo

The name Steven suits a framed gift, and the clean high-resolution file also works as a tattoo design.
